name: 100-things-every-designer-needs-to-know-about-people
title: 100 Things Every Designer Needs to Know About People
author: Susan M. Weinschenk, Ph.D.
description: Susan M. Weinschenk's "100 Things Every Designer Needs to Know About People" — a research-backed design psychology toolkit for creating interfaces, products, and experiences that align with how people actually see, read, remember, think, focus, get motivated, socialize, feel, make mistakes, and decide. Covers 10 use cases: Understanding visual perception, Designing readable interfaces, Optimizing for memory limits, Reducing cognitive load, Grabbing and holding attention, Motivating user action, Leveraging social psychology, Designing for emotion, Preventing user errors, Improving decision-making.
